title: The Small Glasshouse
author: Mara Voss
blurb: Paloma Almeida, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
